region: 35knots.com. Spots marked "verboden" by the NKV are left out.

name: Brouwersdam
notes: Shallow, flat inshore water at low tide on the sea side; the Grevelingen side is a tideless saltwater lake. Separate foil-only zone.

name: Ouddorp
notes: Between beach accesses 7 and 9. Waves and strong ebb current, experienced riders; the sandbank is off-limits (seals).

name: Neeltje Jans
notes: North Sea side, park at the Roompotsluis. Flat at low tide, chop at high tide; advanced riders.

name: Vrouwenpolder
notes: Veerse Gatdam lagoon, best around high tide. From May a buoyed kite zone applies.

name: Kamperland – Roompot
notes: Oosterschelde: long shallow flat water for N–E winds. Stay out of the channel; oyster shells.

name: Domburg
notes: Wave spot by the Westkapelse Zeedijk, experts only; pole rows submerged at high tide. Keep clear of bathing beaches in summer.

name: Cadzand-Bad – Zwin
notes: West of Cadzand-Bad, park at the Zwin visitor centre. Deep water.

name: Cadzand-Bad – Vlamingpolder
notes: Park at the Vlamingpolderweg. Advanced riders.

name: Breskens – Oost
notes: Westerschelde, shallow. Stay well clear of the shipping channel.

name: Borssele – De Kaloot
notes: Westerschelde beach, shallow; never cross the shipping channel.

name: Baarland
notes: Westerschelde: strong currents, advanced riders.

name: Paulinapolder
notes: Westerschelde: only around high tide. Kiting in the channel is forbidden.

name: Terneuzen – Put van Terneuzen
notes: Westerschelde, shallow; stay out of the shipping channel.

name: Oesterdam (Tholen)
notes: Oosterschelde side of the dam, shallow water.

name: Ouwerkerk
notes: Oosterschelde, shallow. Kiting allowed October–April only.

name: Hellevoetsluis – Haringvliet
notes: Haringvliet (no tide), deep water close in.

name: Rockanje
notes: Sportstrand (2nd slag): shallow, all year. The bathing beach next to it only October–April.

name: Oostvoorne
notes: Shallow, beginner-friendly beach. The Oostvoornse Meer (flat-water lake, launch on its north shore) is 1.5 km away.

name: Maasvlakte – Slufter
notes: Shallow, advanced riders. The Maasvlakte 2 P1–P3 section only October–April; P5/P6 is closed.

name: Hoek van Holland
notes: North of the pier, by the Hoekse Watersport Vereniging. Strong currents, not for beginners.

name: 's-Gravenzande – Slag Beukel
notes: Deep water close in; advanced riders.

name: Zandmotor
notes: Sand engine with a shallow lagoon, good for learning. Extra restrictions 15 May–15 Sep.

name: Kijkduin
notes: Surf and currents; submerged groynes. Best wind N.

name: Scheveningen
notes: Noorderstrand zone north of groyne 42 (lighthouse); waves, currents, busy. Quieter Zwarte Pad (KZVS club) 2 km north.

name: Wassenaarse Slag
notes: Deep water close in; advanced riders.

name: Katwijk
notes: Deep water close in; advanced riders.

name: Noordwijk
notes: Kite zone north of the boulevard; advanced riders.

name: Zandvoort
notes: 15 Apr–1 Oct launch only in the six watersport zones (e.g. The Spot); no restrictions the rest of the year.

name: Bloemendaal aan Zee
notes: Advanced riders; currents.

name: IJmuiden
notes: Kennemerstrand south of the pier: flat water in the bay. Zone 2 only October–March.

name: Wijk aan Zee
notes: Zones by the Bunker/HangOut and the north pier.

name: Castricum aan Zee
notes: Shipwreck remains off the beach.

name: Egmond aan Zee
notes: Advanced riders.

name: Bergen aan Zee
notes: Orange activity zones either side of the main beach access (Hang Loose).

name: Camperduin
notes: Small lagoon at low tide, waves outside.

name: Petten
notes: In front of the Hondsbossche dunes; currents, advanced riders.

name: Callantsoog
notes: Advanced riders.

name: Julianadorp
notes: Wide beach; advanced riders.

name: Den Helder – Huisduinen
notes: Marsdiep currents, advanced riders.

name: Texel – Paal 17
notes: Kite zones between poles 17.6 and 19 (De Koog). Waves and currents.

name: Texel – Paal 28
notes: Kite zone between poles 28.2 and 32 (De Cocksdorp).

name: Texel – Dijkmanshuizen
notes: Wadden Sea side, shallow. April–September only; around high tide.

name: Muiderberg
notes: IJmeer, shallow fresh water; beginner-friendly.

name: Almere – Muiderzand
notes: IJmeer, deep water; advanced riders.

name: Edam – Galgenveld
notes: Markermeer, shallow; experts only (stones, dike).

name: Schellinkhout
notes: Markermeer, shallow and flat; beginner-friendly.

name: Medemblik
notes: IJsselmeer, shallow. April–September only.

name: Amstelmeer
notes: Lutjestrand south kite beach (max. 6 riders inside the dam); stones and jetties, advanced riders.

name: Lelystad – Bataviastrand
notes: Markermeer, deep water; advanced riders.

name: Lelystad – Trintelhaven
notes: Houtribdijk, IJsselmeer side. April–July only.

name: Strand Horst
notes: Wolderwijd, shallow flat water; beginner-friendly.

name: Elburg
notes: Veluwemeer, shallow. April–September only.

name: Workum (IJsselmeer)
notes: Shallow fresh water, beginner-friendly.

name: Hindeloopen
notes: Deep water close in.

name: Makkum (IJsselmeer)
notes: Shallow. Kiting allowed October–April only.

name: Kornwerderzand
notes: Afsluitdijk, IJsselmeer side. May–September only; advanced riders.

name: Stavoren
notes: It Suderstrand, deep water; advanced riders.

name: Mirns
notes: Below the Mirnser Klif; shallow, beginner-friendly.

name: Lemmer
notes: Shallow. Kiting allowed October–April only.

name: Harlingen
notes: Wadden Sea, shallow; around high tide.

name: Lauwersoog
notes: Wadden side: shallow, around high tide, all year. Lauwersmeer side June–September only.

name: Vlieland
notes: North Sea beach; the Wadden side is closed.

name: Terschelling – Noordzee
notes: North Sea beach (Midsland aan Zee).

name: Terschelling – Groene Strand
notes: Shallow, flat water near West-Terschelling; beginner-friendly.

name: Ameland – Noordzee
notes: 1 Mar–1 Nov only between poles 8.2–11.3 (Nes/Ballum), 17.4–19 (Buren) and 3–4 (Hollum).

name: Ameland – Waddenzee
notes: By the Nes ferry pier: shallow, 3 h either side of high tide.

name: Schiermonnikoog
notes: North Sea beach between poles 3 and 5; the Wadden side is closed.

name: Delfzijl
notes: Eems-Dollard beach, shallow; around high tide.

name: Oldambtmeer
notes: Midwolda. Kiting allowed October–April only.

name: Zuidlaardermeer
notes: Strand Meerwijck; advanced riders.
